requirements.title: Pointers associated with a TARGET-less allocatable actual do not become associated with a TARGET-less dummy
requirements.definition: For an allocatable dummy argument without TARGET, pointers associated with the actual argument do not become associated with the corresponding dummy argument on procedure invocation.

requirements.definition: After completion of a procedure with a TARGET allocatable dummy meeting the paragraph conditions, pointers that do not become undefined and are associated with the dummy argument remain associated with the actual argument.
